snippet: for (let i = 1; i < parts.length; i++) ev.pathSet.add(parts.slice(0, i).join('/'));
reason: The loop adds every ANCESTOR of a path to pathSet; the path itself is added on the line above. Running one step further adds parts.slice(0, parts.length).join("/"), which IS that same path. pathSet is a Set, so re-adding a member it already holds changes nothing that any criterion can read. Not unkillable-in-practice — unkillable in principle.
